self_digest_rule: For an artifact containing its own digest field, remove exactly that field, RFC8785-canonicalize the remaining JSON object, then SHA-256 the canonical UTF-8 bytes.
payload_digest_rule: Raw detector payload digests are SHA-256 over the exact payload bytes without JSON transformation.
supported_receipt_numeric_profile: I-JSON safe integers only; floating-point JSON numbers are rejected fail-closed by the reference runner.
